items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Interviewer mentions George Russell in context of Lydian Concept classes; Interviewee confirms taking the classes ('A bunch of us were taking it') but does not describe a personal interaction or professional collaboration with Russell himself.

ctx.x: you? Anyway, then with Stanley and them went to Hollywood. They were selling jazz thing it was a bad name, you know?
Well, within that, what was the conversation internally, with a George and with a Stanley and with a Lenny?
They were young kids; they were young guys. As a matter of fact, I got half airfares because Stanley was from Philadelphia and he was playing with the Gene Normandy Youth Orchestra classically.
